gloss: old acquaintance; childhood friend; old friend

definitions.gloss: old acquaintance; childhood friend; old friend
definitions.explanation: A person one has known since long ago, typically from childhood or youth. Implies a deep, long-standing familiarity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{昔馴染|むかしなじ}みだ。
examples.english: He and I are old friends.

examples.japanese: {昔馴染|むかしなじ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to a shop I've known for ages after a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同窓会|どうそうかい}→同窓会：15875_dousoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{昔馴染|むかしなじ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いた→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: I reunited with old friends at a class reunion, and we blossomed into nostalgic conversation.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧ (the past, long ago) + ⟦{馴染|なじ}み→馴染み：07304_najimi⟧ (familiarity, acquaintance). Can refer to people, places, or shops that one has known for a long time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昔馴染|むかしなじ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧: an old friend from way back
- {昔馴染|むかしなじ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧: a shop one has frequented for years
- {昔馴染|むかしなじ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reunite with an old acquaintance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {幼馴染|おさななじ}み: childhood friend — specifically someone known since early childhood; stronger implication of having grown up together
- ⟦{旧友|きゅうゆう}→旧友：17475_kyuuyuu⟧: old friend — more formal and literary
- ⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧: acquaintance — neutral, without the nostalgic or long-standing nuance

USAGE:
Carries a warm, nostalgic tone. Unlike {幼馴染|おさななじ}み}, which specifically refers to childhood, {昔馴染|むかしなじ}み can refer to any long-standing connection from the past.
